d:
Daya draws a festive chit challenge where she must resist dancing to Garba music. Everyone believes she failed and insists Jethalal must become a murga as punishment. Just as he’s cornered, Goli reveals the slip had a 1-minute time limit note that Daya had successfully cleared, saving Jethalal in the nick of time.
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
